in_sanskrit.name: शिवनाथ
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord Shiva or Master of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The combination of 'Shiva' (शिव) and 'Nath' (नाथ) in Sanskrit, where 'Shiva' is the supreme God in Hinduism and is known as the destroyer of evil and the transformer, and 'Nath' is a title given to the enlightened masters and sages. It can be interpreted as 'Lord Shiva' or 'Master of Shiva'.

in_hindi.name: शिवनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'Shivnath' is interpreted as 'शिव के राजा' (King of Shiva) or 'यादित्य राज' (Raja Yaditya, a title of Shiva).

in_tamil.name: சிவநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'Shivnath' is interpreted as 'சிவ அளவர்' (Civa Aalavar, meaning 'Lord Shiva').

in_telugu.name: శివనాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'Shivnath' is interpreted as 'శివ ప్రభు' (Shiva Prabhu, meaning 'Lord Shiva').

in_marathi.name: Shivnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivnath is derived from two words - Shiva (God of destruction) and Nath (Lord). It is believed that the name Shivnath signifies the abode of Lord Shiva. Shivnath is a popular name among Hindus and is considered a powerful and auspicious name.
